section.content: The invention discloses a water-based binder, a preparation method and a lithium battery containing the water-based binder, wherein the water-based binder comprises the following raw materials: the adhesive comprises a polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative and an auxiliary component, wherein the auxiliary component comprises any one or a mixture of more than two of polyacrylic acid, polyethyleneimine and polyvinyl alcohol; the mol ratio of aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer to maleic anhydride derivative monomer in polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative is 1-5: 1-5; the weight ratio of the auxiliary component to the polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative is 1-6. The aqueous binder disclosed by the invention has more oxygen-containing functional groups and more functional sites, and can provide more binding sites for silicon particles; the intermolecular force between the binders is strong, and the electrode structure can be stabilized; the aqueous binder also has a certain dispersion function, so that the lithium ion battery prepared by the aqueous binder has good high-rate performance.

本发明公开了一种水性粘结剂、制备方法及包含水性粘结剂的锂电池，水性粘结剂包括如下原料：聚氨基甲基‑丙烯基醚‑马来酸酐衍生物和辅助成分，辅助成分包括聚丙烯酸、聚乙烯亚胺和聚乙烯醇中的任意一种或两种以上的混合物；聚氨基甲基‑丙烯基醚‑马来酸酐衍生物中氨基甲基‑丙烯基醚单体与马来酸酐衍生物单体的摩尔比为1～5∶1～5；辅助成分与聚氨基甲基‑丙烯基醚‑马来酸酐衍生物的重量比为1～6:1。本发明的水性粘结剂具有较多的含氧官能团和较多的功能位点，能够为硅粒子提供更多的结合位点；粘结剂之间的分子间力强，能够稳定电极结构；该水性粘结剂还具备一定的分散功能，使应用其制备得到的锂离子电池具备良好的高倍率性能。

Water-based binder, preparation method and lithium battery containing water-based binder

Technical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a water-based binder, a preparation method and a lithium battery containing the water-based binder.

Background

The application of the silicon-based negative electrode in the lithium battery can effectively improve the energy density of the single battery cell. However, the commercial application of silicon-based anode materials is still limited by several factors. Among them, the most important one is that the silicon has large volume change in the process of high-degree lithium intercalation, which easily causes the problems of silicon particle cracking and pulverization, electrode powder removal and repeated growth of Solid Electrolyte Interface (SEI) film, and the like, so that the silicon negative electrode has poor cycle stability and low coulombic efficiency. The binder, one of the essential materials for the manufacture of lithium batteries, is present in very small amounts in the electrodes, but has an irreplaceable effect. The conventional binder prevents lithium ion intercalation due to complete coating of the particle surface, resulting in deterioration of charge and discharge kinetics of the lithium battery. How to carry out structural design and composite modification on the binder in the silicon-based negative electrode effectively maintains the integrity of the electrode structure and improves the circulating stability of the silicon-based negative electrode material.

CN113451578A discloses a composite binder and a preparation method and application thereof. The composite binder is a polyvinyl alcohol-metal organic salt composite binder. The composite binder provided by the invention improves the conductivity of the binder by introducing the metal organic salt, so that the prepared silicon cathode has excellent cycling stability and rate capability. Moreover, because the metal organic salt is added, irreversible capacity loss in the first charge-discharge process is too high, capacity attenuation is fast, and practical application of the charge-discharge method is still limited.

CN110350196A discloses a composite binder, a silicon-based negative plate and a preparation method thereof. Polyvinylidene fluoride PVDF with different molecular weights is mixed through a ball mill to obtain a composite binder, and the composite binder can construct a more stable and elastic network framework between electrodes, so that the technical problems of silicon material pulverization and poor multiplying power charge and discharge performance of a silicon-based negative electrode material in a lithium ion embedding and separating process can be solved. But the electrochemical stability of the polyvinylidene fluoride binder is obviously reduced under the high temperature condition, the C-F bond is decomposed at the high temperature, side reaction can be caused in the electrode, and meanwhile, the polyvinylidene fluoride is easy to swell by the electrolyte at higher temperature, and the volume can be obviously changed.

CN105788887A discloses a composite binder, a pole piece prepared by the composite binder, and a preparation method and application thereof. The composite binder consists of phosphoric acid, polyvinylidene fluoride, phenolic resin, amino resin, polyacrylate, acrylate terpolymer latex, sodium carboxymethylcellulose, polyimide, ethanol and N-methylpyrrolidone. The composite binder can reduce the internal resistance of the lithium ion battery and the problems of electrode pulverization, stripping and the like caused by volume expansion of a pole piece, improve the utilization rate of electrode materials and prolong the cycle life. However, the preparation process requires the use of toxic organic solvents such as N-methylpyrrolidone (NMP), which causes high cost due to the use of expensive solvents and the recovery of the solvents.

Therefore, the development of the binder which is green and environment-friendly, and has good cycle performance and high-rate charge and discharge performance has important significance for the development and application of the silicon negative electrode lithium battery.

Disclosure of Invention

Aiming at the problems in the prior art, the invention provides a water-based binder, a preparation method and a lithium battery containing the water-based binder. The adhesive has more oxygen-containing functional groups and more functional sites, is beneficial to effectively accommodating the volume expansion of silicon and enhancing the adhesive force between a silicon-based negative electrode and a copper current collector, and can promote the uniform distribution of active substances and a conductive agent and improve the continuity of a conductive path.

In order to achieve the above object, the present invention adopts the following technical solutions.

An aqueous binder, comprising the following raw materials: the polymer comprises a polyamino methyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative and an auxiliary component, wherein the polyamino methyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative is formed by polymerizing an amino methyl-propenyl ether monomer and a maleic anhydride derivative monomer, and the auxiliary component comprises any one or a mixture of more than two of polyacrylic acid, polyethyleneimine and polyvinyl alcohol; wherein,

As a preferred embodiment, the above aqueous binder is a high molecular weight flexible copolymer in which the molar ratio of aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer to maleic anhydride derivative monomer is 1 to 5:1 to 5 (for example, 2; below this ratio, the cohesive force of the aqueous binder prepared cannot be maintained at a high level, and above this ratio, the mixing is not uniform.

Preferably, the molar ratio of the aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer to the maleic anhydride derivative monomer is 2;

preferably, the weight average molecular weight of the polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative is from 100000 to 2000000g/mol (such as 500000g/mol, 600000g/mol, 700000g/mol, 800000g/mol, 900000g/mol, 1100000g/mol, 1200000g/mol, 1300000 g/mol).

As a preferred embodiment, the weight ratio of the auxiliary component to the polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative is 1 to 6 (for example, 2; preferably, the auxiliary components are polyethyleneimine and polyvinyl alcohol, and the weight ratio of the polyethyleneimine to the polyvinyl alcohol is 0.5-2.

Preferably, the polyacrylic acid or polyethyleneimine or polyvinyl alcohol has a weight average molecular weight of from 100000 to 500000g/mol (such as 110000g/mol, 150000g/mol, 200000g/mol, 250000 g/mol, 300000g/mol, 350000g/mol, 400000g/mol, 450000 g/mol).

In the present invention, the polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative contains a plurality of functional groups (for example, carboxyl group, amine group, alkoxy group, etc.), and in the binder formed by the main component, for example, the carboxyl group (i.e., carboxylic acid group) can be bonded to a hydroxyl group in polyacrylic acid, an amine group in polyethyleneimine, or a hydroxyl group in polyvinyl alcohol to form an ester group or an amide which undergoes chain crosslinking by a condensation reaction, and the ester group or the amide is linked to form a three-dimensional network structure by the combined action of crosslinking and bridging. On the other hand, carboxyl in the binder can form hydrogen bonds and covalent bonds with hydroxyl on the surface of the Si particles, so that the volume expansion of silicon is effectively accommodated, and the adhesion between the silicon-based negative electrode and the copper current collector is enhanced.

In the invention, nitrogen element in amino group in the binder can capture transition metal ions dissolved out of the positive electrode and acid generated by decomposition of the electrolyte, thereby preventing SEI film from being damaged.

In a preferred embodiment, the aqueous binder further comprises water, and the polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative and the auxiliary component are dissolved in the water to form an emulsion binder; preferably, the total mass fraction of the polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative and the auxiliary component in the aqueous binder is between 3 and 13% (such as 4%, 5%, 7%, 9%, 10%, 12%).

The invention also provides a preparation method of the water-based binder, which comprises the following steps:

(1) Adding an alkaline substance and water (such as deionized water) into a reaction kettle under the protection of inert atmosphere, adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to be 8-10, adding an aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer and a maleic anhydride derivative monomer, uniformly mixing and completely dissolving, adding an oxidant, heating to 60-80 ℃, reacting for 12-16 h, drying and washing the obtained polymerization product solution, and drying after suction filtration to obtain a polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative;

(2) Adding the auxiliary components into water according to the formula of the aqueous binder, heating to 60-80 ℃, keeping stirring until the auxiliary components are completely dissolved, cooling to room temperature, keeping constant temperature, then adding the polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative obtained in the step (1), stirring for 4-6 h until the derivative is uniformly dispersed, cooling to room temperature, and sieving to obtain the emulsion binder.

In the above method for producing an aqueous binder, as a preferred embodiment, in the step (1), the molar ratio of the aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer to the maleic anhydride derivative monomer is 1 to 5:1 to 5 (for example, 1.5; below this ratio, the cohesive force of the aqueous binder prepared cannot be maintained at a high level, and above this ratio, the mixing is not uniform.

Preferably, the molar ratio of the aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer to the maleic anhydride derivative monomer is 2.

In the above method for preparing an aqueous binder, as a preferred embodiment, in the step (1), the inert atmosphere is selected from one or two of nitrogen and argon.

In the above method for preparing an aqueous binder, as a preferred embodiment, the oxidizing agent includes one or more selected from the group consisting of ferric toluenesulfonate, ammonium sulfate peroxide, sodium sulfate peroxide and hydrogen peroxide; preferably, the rate of addition of the oxidizing agent is from 3 to 5g/min (e.g., 3g/min, 4g/min, 5 g/min);

preferably, the mass ratio of the maleic anhydride derivative monomer to the oxidizing agent is 2

In the above method for preparing an aqueous binder, as a preferred embodiment, in the step (1), the alkaline substance is one or more of sodium carbonate, sodium hydride (NaH) and sodium hydroxide (NaOH).

In the invention, a basic substance is added to react with the maleic anhydride derivative monomer and provide a basic environment for the reaction system. In the step (1), adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to be 8-10, and opening a maleic anhydride chain in an alkaline environment to form a sodium carboxylate structure of the polymer; the reaction principle of the AB type copolymer when the sodium carboxylate structure is converted into a carboxylic acid structure by adding an oxidizing agent, for example, when a maleic anhydride derivative is reacted with polyaminoethyl vinyl ether, is exemplified below.

In the above method for producing an aqueous binder, as a preferred embodiment, in the step (1), the aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer and the maleic anhydride derivative monomer are added to form a mixed solution in which the total mass fraction of the two monomers is 15 to 20%, and the polymerization effect is more preferable under such conditions.

In the above method for preparing an aqueous binder, as a preferred embodiment, in the step (1), the obtained polymerization product solution is vacuum-dried, washed with absolute ethanol, suction-filtered and vacuum-dried to obtain the polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative.

The invention also provides a lithium ion battery which comprises a positive plate, a negative plate, a diaphragm and electrolyte, wherein the raw materials of the negative plate comprise a negative active substance, a conductive agent, a current collector and the aqueous binder or the aqueous binder prepared by the preparation method.

In a preferred embodiment of the above lithium ion battery, the weight percentage of the binder in the raw material of the negative electrode sheet is 0.5% to 6% (e.g., 1%, 2%, 3%, 4%, 5%), preferably 1% to 4% (e.g., 1.5%, 2%, 2.5%, 3%, 3.5%);

in the above lithium ion battery, as a preferred embodiment, the negative active material includes 0 to 20% (e.g., 2%, 5%, 10%, 15%, 18%) of a silicon material and 80 to 100% (e.g., 82%, 85%, 90%, 95%, 98%) of a carbon material by mass percentage; the silicon material comprises one or more of silicon carbon, silicon oxygen, micron silicon particles, silicon nanowires, carbon-coated silicon particles, silicon-based alloy powder and tin dioxide particles; the carbon material comprises one or more of soft carbon, hard carbon, mesocarbon microbeads, artificial graphite and natural graphite.

In the above lithium ion battery, as a preferred embodiment, the conductive agent includes one or more of conductive graphite, conductive carbon black, carbon nanotubes, VGCF, graphene, and composite fibers.

As a preferred embodiment, the negative electrode sheet is prepared by a preparation method comprising the following steps: diluting the aqueous binder by deionized water, mixing a negative electrode active material and a conductive agent, adding the diluent of the aqueous binder in batches, heating to a constant temperature, keeping stirring, cooling to room temperature to obtain a mixture, coating the mixture on a copper current collector, drying, rolling, and drying in vacuum.

In the above lithium ion battery, as a preferred embodiment, the constant temperature is 30 to 50 ℃ (e.g., 35 ℃, 40 ℃, 45 ℃), the stirring time is 4 to 6 hours (e.g., 4.5 hours, 5 hours, 5.5 hours), and the vacuum drying temperature is 80 to 100 ℃ (e.g., 85 ℃, 90 ℃, 95 ℃) and the time is 8 to 16 hours (e.g., 9 hours, 10 hours, 11 hours, 12 hours, 14 hours, 15 hours).

In the invention, the technical characteristics can be freely combined to form a new technical scheme under the condition of not conflicting with each other.

Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following beneficial technical effects:

(1) The water-based binder provided by the invention is a hydrophilic polymer, can be used as a binder of a high-capacity silicon anode, is low in price, has environmental friendliness, does not discharge three wastes, and is easy to realize large-scale production;

(2) The water-based binder provided by the invention has more oxygen-containing functional groups and more functional sites, and can provide more binding sites for silicon particles; the intermolecular force between the binding agents is strong, and the binding agents have strong tolerance to the volume change and the particle fracture of buffering silicon particles, so that the electrode structure can be stabilized, and a lithium ion battery formed by applying the binding agents has good cycling stability;

(3) The aqueous binder provided by the invention has a certain dispersion function, can improve the continuity of a conductive path by promoting the uniform distribution of an active substance and a conductive agent, and remarkably accelerates the reaction kinetics, so that a lithium ion battery prepared by applying the aqueous binder has good high-rate performance.

Detailed Description

The present invention will be described in detail with reference to examples. The various examples are provided by way of explanation of the invention, and not limitation of the invention. In fact, it will be apparent to those skilled in the art that modifications and variations can be made in the present invention without departing from the scope or spirit thereof. For instance, features illustrated or described as part of one embodiment, can be used with another embodiment to yield a still further embodiment. It is therefore intended that the present invention encompass such modifications and variations as fall within the scope of the appended claims and equivalents thereof.

The parts not specifically described in the following examples are parts by weight.

Example 1

The water-based binder comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 10 parts of a polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative (Mw: 1000000 g/mol), 10 parts of polyethyleneimine (Mw: 300000 g/mol) and 10 parts of polyvinyl alcohol (Mw: 300000 g/mol) which are obtained by polymerizing an aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer and a maleic anhydride derivative monomer; wherein the molar ratio of aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer to maleic anhydride derivative monomer is 2.

The preparation method of the water-based binder comprises the following steps:

(1) Adding sodium carbonate and 250 parts of deionized water into a reaction kettle under the protection of nitrogen, adjusting the pH =9 of an aqueous solution, adding 13 parts of aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer and 12 parts of maleic anhydride derivative monomer, uniformly mixing and ultrasonically treating until the monomers are completely dissolved, adding 24 parts by weight of sodium peroxide at the rate of 4g/min, heating to 70 ℃, reacting for 14 hours, carrying out vacuum drying on a product solution, washing with absolute ethyl alcohol, carrying out suction filtration, and carrying out vacuum drying to obtain a high-molecular flexible copolymer, wherein the Mw is 1000000g/mol; the structure of the maleic anhydride derivative is shown below:

(2) Adding 10 parts of polyethyleneimine (Mw: 300000 g/mol) and 10 parts of polyvinyl alcohol (Mw: 300000 g/mol) into 500 parts by weight of deionized water, heating to 60 ℃, keeping stirring until complete dissolution, cooling, keeping constant temperature, adding 10 parts of high-molecular flexible copolymer, stirring at high speed for 4 hours until uniform dispersion, cooling to room temperature, and sieving with a 500-mesh sieve to obtain the emulsion-shaped binder.

Example 2

The water-based binder comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 10 parts of a polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative (Mw: 700000 g/mol) obtained by polymerizing an aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer and a maleic anhydride derivative monomer, 30 parts of a polyethyleneimine (Mw: 300000 g/mol) and 30 parts of a polyvinyl alcohol (Mw: 300000 g/mol); wherein the molar ratio of the polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer to maleic anhydride derivative monomer is 5. The maleic anhydride derivative has the following structure:

the preparation method of the water-based binder comprises the following steps:

(1) Adding sodium carbonate and 250 parts of deionized water into a reaction kettle under nitrogen, adjusting the pH =9 of an aqueous solution, adding 16 parts of aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer and 6 parts of maleic anhydride derivative monomer, uniformly mixing and performing ultrasonic treatment until the monomers are completely dissolved, adding 12 parts by weight of sodium peroxide at the rate of 4g/min, heating to 70 ℃, reacting for 14h, performing vacuum drying on a product solution, washing with absolute ethyl alcohol, performing suction filtration, and performing vacuum drying to obtain a high-molecular flexible copolymer, wherein the Mw is 700000g/mol.

(2) Adding 30 parts of polyethyleneimine and 30 parts of polyvinyl alcohol into 500 parts of deionized water by weight, heating to 60 ℃, keeping stirring until complete dissolution, cooling, keeping constant temperature, adding 10 parts of high-molecular flexible copolymer, stirring at high speed for 6 hours until uniform dispersion, cooling to room temperature, and sieving with a 500-mesh sieve to obtain the emulsion-like binder.

Example 3

This example was carried out under the same conditions as in example 1 except that 10 parts of polyethyleneimine and 10 parts of polyvinyl alcohol were replaced with 20 parts of polyethyleneimine.

Example 4

This example was carried out under the same conditions as in example 1 except that 10 parts of polyethyleneimine and 10 parts of polyvinyl alcohol were replaced with 20 parts of polyvinyl alcohol.

Example 5

This example was carried out under the same conditions as in example 1 except that 10 parts of polyethyleneimine and 10 parts of polyvinyl alcohol were replaced with 20 parts of polyacrylic acid (Mw: 300000 g/mol).

Example 6

Comparative example 1

The binder of the comparative example does not contain a high-molecular flexible copolymer, and the specific preparation method is as follows: adding 10 parts by weight of polyethyleneimine (Mw: 300000 g/mol) and 10 parts by weight of polyvinyl alcohol (Mw: 300000 g/mol) into 500 parts by weight of deionized water, heating to 60 ℃, keeping stirring until complete dissolution, cooling and keeping constant temperature, stirring at high speed for 4 hours until uniform dispersion, cooling to room temperature, and sieving with a 500-mesh sieve to obtain the emulsion-shaped binder.

Comparative example 2

The binder of this comparative example contained only 20 parts of polyacrylic acid, no polyethyleneimine and polyvinyl alcohol, and no high molecular flexible copolymer. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding 20 parts of polyacrylic acid (Mw: 300000 g/mol) into 500 parts by weight of deionized water, heating to 60 ℃, keeping stirring until the polyacrylic acid is completely dissolved, cooling and keeping constant temperature, stirring at high speed for 4 hours until the polyacrylic acid is uniformly dispersed, cooling to room temperature, and sieving with a 500-mesh sieve to obtain the emulsion-shaped binder.

Comparative example 3

The preparation method of the high molecular flexible copolymer in the comparative example is the same as that in example 1, namely the step (1) in the preparation method of the aqueous binder is the same as that in example 1, but the aqueous binder in the comparative example only contains the high molecular flexible copolymer and does not contain polyethyleneimine and polyvinyl alcohol, and the step (2) is specifically as follows: adding 30 parts by weight of high-molecular flexible copolymer into 500 parts by weight of deionized water, stirring at a high speed for 4 hours until the mixture is uniformly dispersed, cooling to room temperature, and sieving by a 500-mesh sieve to obtain the emulsion-shaped binder.

Comparative example 4

The comparative example was conducted under the same conditions as in example 1 except that 3 parts of the high molecular flexible copolymer was used instead of 10 parts.

Comparative example 5

The water-based binder comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 10 parts of polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative, 10 parts of polyethyleneimine and 10 parts of polyvinyl alcohol, wherein the polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative is polymerized from an aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer and a maleic anhydride derivative monomer; wherein the molar ratio of aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer to maleic anhydride derivative monomer is 6. The preparation method of the water-based binder comprises the following steps:

adding sodium carbonate and 250 parts by weight of deionized water into a reaction kettle under nitrogen, adjusting the pH of an aqueous solution to be =9, adding 19 parts by weight of aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer and 6 parts by weight of maleic anhydride derivative monomer (the structure of the maleic anhydride derivative monomer is the same as that of example 1), uniformly mixing, performing ultrasonic treatment until the monomers are completely dissolved, adding 12 parts by weight of sodium peroxide at the rate of 4g/min, heating to 70 ℃, reacting for 14 hours, performing vacuum drying on a product solution, washing with absolute ethyl alcohol, performing vacuum drying after suction filtration to obtain a high-molecular flexible copolymer, wherein the Mw is 600000g/mol; .

Adding 10 parts of polyethyleneimine and 10 parts of polyvinyl alcohol into 500 parts by weight of deionized water, heating to 60 ℃, keeping stirring until the polyethyleneimine and the polyvinyl alcohol are completely dissolved, cooling and keeping the temperature constant, adding 10 parts of high-molecular flexible copolymer, stirring at a high speed for 4 hours until the mixture is uniformly dispersed, cooling to room temperature, and sieving by a sieve of 500 meshes to obtain the emulsion-shaped binder.

Assembling and testing the lithium ion battery:

soft pack 505060 lithium ion batteries were fabricated using the soft pack lamination process using the binders of examples 1-6 and comparative examples 1-5. Laminating an NCM523 positive plate, a silicon-based graphite negative plate (wherein, the mass percentage of silicon to graphite, a conductive agent and a binder is 9.5%:85.5%:2.0%: 3.0%) and a polyethylene diaphragm (such as a PE + OBS diaphragm), baking after assembly until the moisture is qualified, injecting electrolyte, carrying out hot pressing formation, carrying out high-temperature standing and packaging, carrying out capacity grading, carrying out normal-temperature standing to obtain a soft package 505060 finished battery, carrying out viscosity test on the binder, carrying out adhesion test on the silicon-based graphite negative plate, and carrying out electrochemical performance test on the battery.

And (3) viscosity testing:

testing at 25 ℃ on a battery testing system of an electrochemical workstation, wherein the tested current densities are 1C, 3C and 5C, the charging capacity under 3C/5C multiplying power is calculated to be divided by the charging capacity under 1C multiplying power, and the obtained percentage values are respectively a 3C capacity retention rate and a 5C capacity retention rate; the charge and discharge voltage window is 2.8V-4.3V, see Table 1.

In combination with the viscosity data of the adhesive in table 1, it can be seen from examples 1 to 6 and comparative examples 1 to 5 that the flexible polymer copolymer prepared by polymerizing the aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer and the maleic anhydride derivative monomer according to the present invention has better adhesion than the adhesive formed by polyacrylic acid, polyethyleneimine or polyvinyl alcohol alone or in combination thereof.

The reason that the high-molecular flexible copolymer prepared by the invention has more oxygen-containing functional groups and more functional sites can be attributed to the fact that the high-molecular flexible copolymer can form a cross-linked network with polyacrylic acid/polyethyleneimine/polyvinyl alcohol and is beneficial to enhancing the adhesive force between a silicon-based negative electrode and a copper current collector.

Combining the cycling tests and rate test data of Table 1, it can be seen that the lithium cells were cycled to 80% SOH, with example 1 having the most cycles, the best cycle stability, and the best 3C/5C discharge rate. The crosslinked network formed by the high-molecular flexible copolymer and polyacrylic acid/polyethyleneimine/polyvinyl alcohol can effectively relieve the expansion of a silicon material in the circulating process, promote the uniform distribution of active substances and a conductive agent, further improve the structural stability of an electrode, and improve the circulating performance and the rate capability of a lithium ion battery.

Further, as is clear from comparative example 3 in table 1, when the binder contains only the polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative without containing an auxiliary component, the negative electrode sheet produced using the binder, although having a high adhesive force with respect to the aqueous binder containing an auxiliary component, cannot be bonded with carboxylic acid groups in auxiliary components such as polyacrylic acid, polyethyleneimine, polyvinyl alcohol, etc. to form ester groups chain-crosslinked by a condensation reaction, and thus cannot have a better long-cycle structural stability as in example 1, and thus the lithium battery of comparative example 3 has a smaller number of cycles of 80% soh.

As can be seen from comparative example 4 in table 1, although the aqueous binder in comparative example 4 contains certain amounts of polyethyleneimine and polyvinyl alcohol auxiliary components, which can ensure the relative viscosity of the binder, the negative electrode sheet prepared using the binder has a low cohesive force due to the relatively small amount of the polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative added, resulting in a lithium battery having a small cycle number of 80% soh.

As can be seen from comparative example 5 in table 1, in the polyaminomethyl-propenyl ether-maleic anhydride derivative of comparative example 5, the molar ratio of aminomethyl-propenyl ether monomer to maleic anhydride derivative monomer is 6, which is lower than the protection range (1 to 5:1 to 5) of the ratio of the two monomers in the present invention, the molecular weight of the produced polymerization product is lower and the product is relatively less, thus resulting in a low viscosity of the aqueous binder of comparative example 5, resulting in a relatively low adhesion of the negative electrode sheet and a relatively low number of cycles of lithium battery 80 soh.

In conclusion, the aqueous binder prepared by the technical scheme of the invention has more oxygen-containing functional groups and more functional sites, and can provide more binding sites for silicon particles; the intermolecular force between the binding agents is strong, and the binding agents have strong tolerance to the volume change and the particle fracture of buffering silicon particles, so that the electrode structure can be stabilized, and a lithium ion battery formed by applying the binding agents has good cycling stability. In addition, the aqueous binder has a certain dispersion function, can improve the continuity of a conductive path by promoting the uniform distribution of an active substance and a conductive agent, and remarkably accelerates the reaction kinetics, so that the lithium ion battery prepared by the aqueous binder has good high-rate performance.
